newsitem.title: DENMARK: Carlsberg rebounds from British shock.
newsitem.headline: Carlsberg rebounds from British shock.

text.p: Danish brewer Carlsberg staged a strong rally on Monday, rising 3.37 percent in early trade and more than regaining losses incurred after Britain blocked a planned sell-off of its Carlsberg-Tetley unit.
At 0845 GMT the share stood at 368.00 crowns, up from its Friday close of 356.00 and higher than the 365.00 crowns it commanded before Friday's British government announcement.

Analysts said that Friday's fall was exaggerated and that in buying back British brewer Bass' half of Carlsberg-Tetley for 110 million pounds Carlberg was acquiring a well-run brewery at below market price. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
